title: Prayer For Healing A Broken Heart | God Is Near To The Brokenhearted (Psalm 34:18)
description:
A prayer for healing a broken heart. God is near to the brokenhearted.

For anyone carrying grief, a loss or a heavy heart: Jesus wept, God keeps count of your tears, and he binds up wounds. Scripture read slowly, then a prayer for healing.

"The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit." Psalm 34:18 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Psalm 34:18, John 11:35, Isaiah 53:3, Psalm 56:8, Psalm 147:3, Matthew 5:4, Psalm 73:26, Romans 8:38-39, 2 Corinthians 1:3-4, Psalm 30:5, Revelation 21:4.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
